title: FMART W6 Window Cleaner Robot Review: 3800Pa Suction & Dual Ultrasonic Spray
metaDescription: In-depth FMART W6 window cleaning robot review: 3800Pa suction power, dual ultrasonic water spray, AI edge detection sensors, app control, and comparison with competitors.
author: ByteBuy Team

sections.content: Cleaning high-rise windows, frameless glass partitions, or large outdoor mirrors can be both risky and exhausting. The FMART W6 Window Cleaner Robot offers an automated solution with 3800Pa suction power and dual ultrasonic water spray nozzles that atomize liquid into fine 12μm droplets. Featuring AI intelligent path planning (Z/N routes), high-sensitivity edge leakage detection sensors, and triple anti-fall safety mechanisms (including a 20-minute UPS battery backup), this square-shaped glass washer promises streak-free results across frameless and framed surfaces alike.

pros: Strong 3800Pa vertical suction ensures solid adherence to glass and tile surfaces
Dual ultrasonic spray nozzles evenly coat glass without leaving wet drips or streaks
Square body design cleans window edges and corners much better than oval dual-wheel robots
AI edge detection sensors allow safe operation on frameless glass doors and shower enclosures
Triple safety design: high-strength tether, pressure-loss detection, and 20-min emergency UPS backup
Dual control via intuitive smartphone app and dedicated 2.4G remote
cons: Requires AC power cord connection during cleaning (UPS battery is for anti-fall emergency only)
Extremely stubborn dried mud or baked-on dirt may require a pre-wipe or second cleaning pass
Water tanks require periodic refill during multi-window cleaning sessions

items.question: Can the FMART W6 be used on frameless glass doors or shower cabins?
items.answer: Yes, the FMART W6 features high-sensitivity air pressure sensors along its edges that detect frame edges or open glass limits, preventing the vacuum seal from breaking and stopping the robot before it drives off the edge.

items.question: What happens if the power cord gets accidentally unplugged?
items.answer: The robot has a built-in UPS emergency battery backup that maintains suction for up to 20 minutes while sounding an audible warning alarm, allowing you to safely retrieve it using the safety tether.

items.question: Does it require special window cleaning solution?
items.answer: You can fill the dual 25ml tanks with clean water or standard non-foaming window cleaner liquid. Avoid thick or viscous detergents that could clog the fine 12μm ultrasonic spray nozzles.

items.question: Are the microfiber cleaning cloths reusable?
items.answer: Yes, the microfiber pads are machine washable and reusable. Replacing or flipping them when noticeably dirty ensures streak-free cleaning results.

sections.content: The FMART W6 Window Cleaner Robot delivers solid cleaning performance for anyone looking to eliminate hand-cleaning high windows, balconies, or frameless mirrors. With its reliable 3800Pa suction, dual ultrasonic fine spray, edge-detection intelligence, and square design that tackles corners effectively, it provides high-end window cleaning capabilities at a mid-range price point.
